metrics: manual atom/rule/query agreement on admitted interpretation
coverage by stratum, never counting safe suspension as comprehension
certificate replay where a certificate is produced
release_safety_gates: No admitted claim contradicts the manually annotated interpretation.
All examined source bytes restore exactly.
No question/command/wish/prohibition or unresolved pronoun supplies an unwarranted assertion.
Every admitted revision episode updates all tested dependencies correctly.
coverage_reporting: Report raw counts and all failures; compare old v1 and new bridge on same bytes. No whole-Arabic or randomly sampled population claim. Unsupported forms count as unrecognized, not successful understanding.
noninterference: Evaluator has read existing docs and original book bytes only; no new implementation or builder tests read before this dataset freeze. Builder receives only hashes and protocol until runtime freeze.
gold_limits: Natural-language annotations authored by one evaluator; not independently adjudicated linguistic truth.
Some forms may exceed declared implementation scope and intentionally test safe refusal.
Status UNKNOWN and OUT_OF_SCOPE are both accepted only where source withdrawal removes the final predicate signature.
A quoted grammatical example is analyzed as an example; parsing does not claim the example describes the actual world.
